description: List messages in a channel, anchored at a timestamp or message id. Provide EITHER message_ts (unix ms) OR message_id. Platform API: GET /{channel_type}/{channel_url}/messages. Returns { messages[] }.

channel_type.description: Channel type: group_channels (member-based) or open_channels (public, participant-based).

custom_types.description: Comma-separated message custom types to filter on.

message_id.description: Anchor message id. Provide this OR message_ts.

message_ts.description: Anchor timestamp in unix milliseconds. Provide this OR message_id.

message_type.description: Filter by message type: MESG (text), FILE, or ADMM (admin).

next_limit.description: Number of messages after the anchor, 0-200.

prev_limit.description: Number of messages before the anchor, 0-200.

user_ids.description: Comma-separated sender user ids to filter on.

name: sendbird_list_messages
title: List messages
